description: Schema 9.26.0 — a modal sheet is dismissed by a drag down (rules: x-sheetDismiss). «startCases»: whether a move of the finger drags the sheet instead of scrolling its body: the layer is a sheet from the bottom (not a centred window), it can be dismissed, how far its body is scrolled from the top, the move (logical pixels, down positive) and whether the finger lies on the handle; «expect» — true or false. «releaseCases»: the height of the sheet, how far it was dragged down and the velocity at release (logical pixels per second, down positive); «expect» — «dismiss» or «return». «entryCases»: a screen entry; «expect» — whether a person can dismiss its layer. «documentCases»: screen entries; «expect» — the validation codes. «ruleCases»: data of the block. «escapeCases», «escapeRuleCases» (rules: x-modalEscape, clarified before release): «escapeCases» — a key down with or without «repeat» (an auto-repeated key held down), whether the top of the stack is a modal layer and whether a person can dismiss it; «expect» — how many steps back it makes, 0 or 1. «escapeRuleCases»: data of x-modalEscape. Written by hand.

startCases.name: down past the slop at the top of the body
down within the slop — not yet
more sideways than down — a horizontal gesture
the body is scrolled away from its top — the body scrolls back first
on the handle the sheet moves even when the body is scrolled
a centred window has no drag

releaseCases.name: dragged a third of the height — dismiss
just short of the share — return
a short drag thrown down fast — dismiss
a short drag thrown slower — return
far down but thrown back up — return
a slow drift up after a long drag — the share decides
a short sheet: the same share

entryCases.name: no field — a person can dismiss
«dismissible: false» — only an action inside closes it

documentCases.name: a modal sheet that waits for an action
a centred window that waits for an action
on a page — nothing to dismiss

escapeCases.name: Esc on a dismissible layer — one step back
Esc held — a repeat closes nothing
Esc on a layer that waits for an action — nothing, the layer below is not closed
Esc on a page — not the reader’s

escapeRuleCases.name: who listens
escapeRuleCases.expect: the top layer of the stack only

escapeRuleCases.name: the same rule as Enter and Space
